name: Meats to Orgrimmar
summary: At the Crossroads, Zargh sends a parcel of Barrens meat toward Orgrimmar. He asks young orc and troll adventurers to carry it to Devrak, the wind rider master, and learn the flight route to the Horde capital.

sections.title: Fresh Game from the Barrens
sections.body: Wildlife fills the Barrens, from zhevras and plainstriders to kodos and thunder lizards. Zargh has prepared choice cuts for a personal delivery to Gryshka, the innkeeper in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength. Rather than risk the long, dusty trek across the Southfury River into Durotar, he sends runners from the Crossroads to the wind rider perch.

sections.title: Wings Over the Steppes
sections.body: Meeting Devrak gives a young Horde warrior a first look at the wind rider flight network. Wind rider masters connect remote outposts like the Crossroads to the Horde's fortified seat of power in Orgrimmar. Devrak prepares you and the cargo for a swift flight over the savannah.

faq.q: Who is Zargh sending this meat to?
faq.answer: Zargh sends the meat to his friend Gryshka, the innkeeper of Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.

faq.q: Why can only Orcs and Trolls take this quest?
faq.answer: This flight introduction links orcs and Darkspear trolls to their shared capital, Orgrimmar. Tauren are directed to Thunder Bluff through A Bundle of Hides, while Forsaken are sent to Silverpine Forest through Supplying the Sepulcher.
Devrak is the orc wind rider master stationed at the Crossroads in the Barrens. He oversees the wyverns that carry messages, supplies, and travelers throughout Kalimdor.

faq.q: What happens after giving the meat to Devrak?
aliases: next quest after meats to orgrimmar
faq.answer: Devrak accepts the shipment and arranges a wind rider flight that carries you and the meat to Orgrimmar's Skytower. You then deliver it to Gryshka at her inn through Ride to Orgrimmar.
Zargh is at the Crossroads, the central Horde trading hub at the Barrens' main intersection.

faq.q: Why use a wind rider instead of walking?
faq.answer: Wind riders carry travelers rapidly across the harsh Barrens and over the river canyon into Durotar, so delicate cargo like fresh meat can reach Orgrimmar before spoiling.

angles.text: As an orc leaving Durotar to hunt in the Barrens, you can deliver Zargh's parcel and establish an aerial route straight back to the Warchief's capital.
As a Darkspear troll at the Crossroads, you help tie the expanding wilderness outposts into Orgrimmar's supply lines.
As a cook, you help bring fresh Barrens cuts to Gryshka's inn in Orgrimmar, keeping the capital's stewpots filled for visiting warriors.
